About me

Hi, I’m Faith Obatunde, an SEO & Digital Marketing Strategist who enjoys turning digital challenges into opportunities for growth. I’ve helped businesses across different industries build a stronger online presence through SEO, website optimisation, content strategy and performance marketing. I enjoy understanding how a business works, figuring out what’s holding back its visibility and finding practical ways to reach the right people.

At Scalabu Digital, I lead and mentor five SEO and digital marketing interns. I guide their work on client projects, review deliverables and help them build confidence in what they do. I’m naturally curious, particular about the details and always learning. I love seeing an idea turn into something measurable, whether that’s a website becoming easier to find or someone I’ve mentored getting more confident in their work.

Auxilum Interactive

I led organic search delivery for a software development company and coached an intern through their first client engagement.

AgencyScalabu Digital
EngagementJune–November 2026
FocusSEO and team leadership

Project summary

Auxilum Interactive is a software development company. It needed stronger search visibility and a regular presence across organic channels.

I led the SEO and content strategy, oversaw content for its existing LinkedIn page, and guided an intern through delivery. Google Search Console recorded 60,998 impressions and 309 organic clicks from 16 June to 7 November 2026.

Organic search

Organic clicks rose from 69 to 131 in one month

I developed the SEO strategy, planned content and monitored the site’s search performance. The increase was recorded between September and October 2026.

Team leadership

An intern’s first client engagement

I created the project template, taught the workflow and reviewed deliverables as the intern worked through the engagement.

Organic channels

Growing LinkedIn and opening two new channels

I supervised content and growth on Auxilum’s existing LinkedIn page. We also launched its Quora and Nairaland profiles.

Google Search Console

Results in numbers

60,998Search impressions
309Organic clicks
+90%Monthly organic click growth

Project summary

ElsaLagos is an online jewelry store on Shopify. Its collections and products needed to be easier to find through search.

I optimised collections, individual product pages and selected articles around relevant shopping and informational queries. Google Search Console recorded approximately 13,000 impressions and 547 organic clicks from 10 May to 6 July 2026.

Collection and product SEO

I optimised collections and products for search

Commercial search

Collections appeared for jewelry shopping queries

On 10 November 2026, the body jewelry and colourful earrings collections were observed in first position for their respective queries.

Articles and AI search

Henok Oil

I ran a Google Ads search campaign for a bulk diesel supplier and verified that GA4 recorded the website’s form submission event.

AgencyScalabu Digital
EngagementJuly–August 2026
FocusGoogle Ads and form tracking

Project summary

Henok Oil supplies bulk diesel. The project needed to reach people searching for diesel suppliers and test whether website form activity could be measured.

I built a Google Ads search campaign around relevant buying terms and set up form-event tracking through Google Tag Manager and GA4. The campaign recorded 19 ad clicks and a 10.67% click-through rate from 29 July to 7 August 2026. A test submission confirmed that the form event reached GA4.

Campaign strategy

I built the campaign around diesel supply searches

I wrote ad copy, targeted terms such as “diesel supplier in Lagos” and “bulk diesel prices”, and used negative keywords to exclude unrelated searches.

Google Ads · 29 July–7 August 2026

Campaign results

The campaign spent $44.74, with an average cost per click of $2.35.

178Ad impressions
19Ad clicks
10.67%Click-through rate

Tracking verification

I verified that the form event reached GA4

I used Google Tag Manager to detect the WPForms success message, fire the generate_lead event and verify that GA4 received it.
